Point2.description: A sketch point in mm: [x, y] or {"x", "y"}.

SketchTarget.description: The sketch: its feature id or its name (default: the one being edited).

SlotWidth.description: The slot's width in mm: more than 0.000000001 and below 1 000 000 000.

Sweep.description: The sweep in degrees, counter-clockwise from `start`; the sketch refuses one that is not above 0 and below 360.

input.description:
Draw a slot along an arc from its centre, the start of its centre arc and its end or sweep.
Returns `centre_arc`: the construction arc along the slot's middle.

center.description: The centre of the arcs, [x, y] in mm.

end.description:
Without `sweep`: a point in the direction of the centre arc's end from `center` (the arc
runs counter-clockwise from `start` to it), [x, y] in mm.

sketch.description: The sketch (default: the one being edited).

start.description: The centre arc's start, [x, y] in mm; its distance from `center` is the arc's radius.

sweep.description:
How far the centre arc turns counter-clockwise, in degrees (0 to 360, not including
either). Wins over `end`, which is then not read.

input.title: ArcSlotCenterParams

label: Center Point Arc Slot

centre_arc.description: The id of the construction arc along the slot's middle.

constraints.description: The ids of the constraints made.

created.description: What it added: `{points, curves, constraints, dimensions}`.

curves.description: The ids of the curves made.

middle.description: The point held halfway along the construction centre arc.

param_warnings.description: In the warn parameter-check mode: what the call's parameters got wrong.

params: center, start: centre arc start, end: direction of the centre arc end (counter-clockwise) or sweep: degrees (0 < sweep < 360), width; returns centre_arc and middle. Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)
